::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Aug 21st 1893  
**From:** Elderfield  
**Manuscript:** MS Princeton University, Parrish Collection
:::

Dear [Mrs Holbeach](people/person_706.qmd)[^1]
I am much obliged for your book which I should have acknowledged sooner but I was just going from home

I chiefly took the account of the battle of Wakefield from Sir James Ramsays’[history](other_books/otherbook_679.qmd), and as it was a hired book I cannot see whether any bit of old spelling of his could have misled me. I am afraid it is too late to get it altered in the second edition[^2]

Yours truly
C M Yonge

---

[^1]: With envelope addressed to ‘Mrs Holbeach/ Farnborough Hall/ Banbury’.
[^2]: Mary Caroline (Walrond) Holbeach (1854-1933), wife of Walter Henry Holbeach (1846-1901) of Farnborough Hall.
[^3]: This seems most likely to be a reference to Grisly Grisell.
